completeClassCounterpart.effect: While at least two hostile creatures within 30 feet are currently Shaken, Frightened or Disoriented by your Warrior features, reduce the first damage you take each round by 2.
completeClassCounterpart.prerequisite: Warrior 8; Carrion Signal Gland equipped; eligible feat grant

source.originalText: | Terror Engine | Carrion Signal Gland | If 2+ enemies are Shaken or Disoriented, gain +2 DR |

completeWarriorCounterpartPairs.relationship: same named source-row subject; identity/acquisition and effect reconciliation pending; not two automatic grants

completeWarriorMutationCards.name: Ironhide Graft
completeWarriorMutationCards.effect: Gain +2 AC against melee attack rolls and reduce the first physical weapon damage you take each round by 1.

source.originalText: | Ironhide Graft | +2 AC vs melee, +1 DR |

completeWarriorMutationCards.name: Bloodthick Node
completeWarriorMutationCards.duration: While active during a real encounter
completeWarriorMutationCards.frequency: Once at start of each regular turn
completeWarriorMutationCards.effect: Regain HP equal to current BT, maximum 3 HP per turn or 4 with Stack Overflow. No healing occurs outside a real encounter and it removes no Wounds. Each HP actually restored spends 1 Mutation Recovery Reserve; heal no more than remaining reserve.

source.originalText: | Bloodthick Node | Heal 1 HP per BT stack each round |

completeWarriorMutationCards.name: Spinal Buffer
completeWarriorMutationCards.effect: Gain +1 on saving throws against being knocked Prone, Stunned or forcibly moved. If an effect uses an ability check rather than a save, add +1 to that check instead.

source.originalText: | Spinal Buffer | +1 Save vs knockback, stuns, and forced movement |

completeWarriorMutationCards.name: Flesh Warden
completeWarriorMutationCards.effect: Increase maximum HP by 2 per Warrior level while equipped. Equipping raises maximum only, never current HP. Unequipping clamps current HP to the reduced maximum if necessary; it does not subtract another amount from current HP. Repeated swaps cannot heal.

source.originalText: | Flesh Warden | +2 HP per level |

completeWarriorMutationCards.name: Plated Shoulder
completeWarriorMutationCards.effect: While adjacent to substantial terrain, a wall or a willing ally of your size or larger, you gain half cover against ranged attacks.

source.originalText: | Plated Shoulder | Gain half cover while standing adjacent to terrain or ally |

completeWarriorMutationCards.name: Redundant Organs
completeWarriorMutationCards.effect: When damage would reduce you to 0 HP without killing you outright, remain at 1 HP instead.

source.originalText: | Redundant Organs | First time you'd fall to 0 HP, stay at 1 (1/long rest) |

completeWarriorMutationCards.name: Rapid Coagulation
completeWarriorMutationCards.duration: While active during a real encounter
completeWarriorMutationCards.effect: If you did not move during your previous turn, regain 2 HP at the start of your current turn. This does not function outside a real encounter. Each HP actually restored spends 1 Mutation Recovery Reserve; heal no more than remaining reserve.

source.originalText: | Rapid Coagulation | Gain Regeneration 2 if you haven't moved this round |

completeWarriorMutationCards.name: Ossified Core
completeWarriorMutationCards.effect: Critical hits against you do not add extra critical damage dice. Additionally reduce piercing damage you take by 2 after resistance.

source.originalText: | Ossified Core | Immune to crit damage; take 2 less damage from piercing attacks |

completeWarriorMutationCards.name: Adrenal Floodgate
completeWarriorMutationCards.effect: When you first fall to one-quarter maximum HP or less, regain 2d8 HP and end either Frightened, Poisoned or Staggered on yourself.

source.originalText: | Adrenal Floodgate | Once per encounter, heal 2d8 HP and remove 1 condition when you drop below 25% HP |

completeWarriorMutationCards.name: Thickened Bone Weave
completeWarriorMutationCards.duration: Until end of your next regular turn
completeWarriorMutationCards.effect: When you activate a serum or gain at least 1 BT, gain DR 2 against physical weapon damage until the end of your next regular turn. Reapplication refreshes but does not stack.

source.originalText: | Thickened Bone Weave | +2 DR for 2 rounds after using a serum or gaining a BT stack |

completeWarriorMutationCards.name: Mythic Carapace
completeWarriorMutationCards.duration: Until encounter ends, mutation ends or you fall below one-quarter maximum HP
completeWarriorMutationCards.effect: Gain DR 3 against all damage and immunity to Bleed, Poisoned and Burn-style ongoing fire effects. Once per encounter when one hit deals more than 20 actual damage after mitigation, gain 1 BT and refresh the remaining duration of your other active mutations to 3 rounds. It grants no serum-profile refresh.
completeWarriorMutationCards.prerequisite: Warrior 15; Apex Vital; maximum one Apex equipped

source.originalText:
| Mythic Carapace | While this is active:
- +3 DR flat
- Immune to Bleed, Poison, and Burn
- Once per combat, when you're struck for more than 20 damage: immediately gain +1 BT and refresh all active mutations
- Lasts until the end of combat or you fall below 25% HP |

completeWarriorMutationCards.name: Brute Knuckles
completeWarriorMutationCards.effect: Your unarmed strike damage die becomes 1d10. On an unarmed critical hit, the target makes a Strength save; on failure it drops one non-attuned held item of its choice.

source.originalText: | Brute Knuckles | Unarmed strikes deal 1d10 and apply Disarm on crit |

completeWarriorMutationCards.name: Splinter Bone Fangs
completeWarriorMutationCards.rangeAndTarget: Creature critically hit by your melee attack
completeWarriorMutationCards.frequency: At most once per target per turn
completeWarriorMutationCards.effect: A melee critical applies Bleed. The target takes 1d4 physical damage at the start of each of its next 2 turns. Reapplication refreshes rather than stacks.

source.originalText: | Splinter Bone Fangs | Melee crits cause 1d4 bleed for 2 rounds |

completeWarriorMutationCards.name: Lashing Ligaments
completeWarriorMutationCards.effect: For one melee attack on your turn, increase your reach by 5 feet. Using the extended reach does not itself provoke opportunity attacks.

source.originalText: | Lashing Ligaments | Gain +5 ft melee reach once per turn (doesn't provoke AoO) |

completeWarriorMutationCards.name: Jaw Clench Node
completeWarriorMutationCards.duration: Until end of your next regular turn
completeWarriorMutationCards.effect: After you score a critical hit, gain +1 on attack rolls and +2 on Intimidation checks until the end of your next regular turn.

source.originalText: | Jaw Clench Node | Gain +1 to hit and +2 to Intimidation for 1 round after crit |

completeWarriorMutationCards.name: Shoulder Spike Cluster
completeWarriorMutationCards.rangeAndTarget: Creature grappling you or grappled by you
completeWarriorMutationCards.effect: When a grapple is established or maintained against you, or you successfully establish a grapple, the other creature takes 1d6 piercing damage.

source.originalText: | Shoulder Spike Cluster | When grappling or being grappled, attacker takes 1d6 damage |

completeWarriorMutationCards.name: Shock Muscle Weave
completeWarriorMutationCards.effect: When you take the ordinary Attack action, make one additional melee weapon attack. This additional attack is not a new Action and cannot itself grant another attack. It does not apply to card techniques unless they explicitly use the ordinary Attack action.

source.originalText: | Shock Muscle Weave | Gain +1 attack per turn (stacks with extra attacks, but only melee) |

completeWarriorMutationCards.name: Razorbone Growths
completeWarriorMutationCards.effect: Your melee attacks ignore 1 point of flat DR. Resistance and immunity are unaffected.

source.originalText: | Razorbone Growths | All melee attacks ignore 1 point of DR |

completeWarriorMutationCards.name: Echo Knuckles
completeWarriorMutationCards.effect: After you hit with a melee attack, make one offhand slam against the same target using your Warrior technique attack. On hit deal 1d8+M bludgeoning damage. This is a free attack, cannot trigger Echo Knuckles again and cannot grant another free attack.

source.originalText: | Echo Knuckles | Once per round, after hitting, make a free offhand slam (1d8) |

completeWarriorMutationCards.name: Adrenal Backlash Core
completeWarriorMutationCards.duration: Until end of your next regular turn
completeWarriorMutationCards.effect: After you take damage, empower your next melee hit before the end of your next regular turn to deal +2d6 damage of the weapon's normal type. A new trigger refreshes but does not stack.

source.originalText: | Adrenal Backlash Core | When you take damage, your next melee hit deals +2d6 |

completeWarriorMutationCards.name: Warpgrip Talons
completeWarriorMutationCards.rangeAndTarget: Creature critically hit by your melee attack
completeWarriorMutationCards.frequency: At most once per target per turn
completeWarriorMutationCards.effect: A melee critical applies Weakened for 2 rounds. While Weakened, the target deals 1 less damage with each weapon or natural-weapon hit, minimum 0. Reapplication refreshes rather than stacks.

source.originalText: | Warpgrip Talons | Melee attacks apply Weakened on crit (–1 damage from target for 2 rounds) |

completeWarriorMutationCards.name: Butcherform Chassis
completeWarriorMutationCards.duration: 3 rounds or until below one-quarter maximum HP
completeWarriorMutationCards.effect: When you take the ordinary Attack action, make one additional melee attack beyond other Extra Attack effects, respecting the one-additional-full-Action guard because this is part of the same Action. Your melee criticals add one extra weapon damage die beyond normal critical dice, not triple total damage. Once per round when you personally kill a meaningful hostile with a melee attack, restore one consumed prepared serum dose, never above reserve capacity.
completeWarriorMutationCards.prerequisite: Warrior 15; Apex Combat; maximum one Apex equipped

source.originalText:
| Butcherform Chassis | While active:
- Gain +2 attacks per round
- Crits deal triple damage
- Melee kills instantly refresh 1 serum or 1 mutation use
- Lasts for 3 rounds or until you're below 25% HP |

completeWarriorMutationCards.name: Ink-Slick Glands
completeWarriorMutationCards.effect: Create opaque black mist. Creatures outside the cloud cannot see through it; ranged attacks passing through the cloud have disadvantage. Wind or an equivalent dispersal effect may end it early.

source.originalText: | Ink-Slick Glands | Once per rest, exude a cloud of black mist (3x3, blocks LoS, causes Disadvantage on ranged attacks) |

completeWarriorMutationCards.name: Pulsing Vein Spiral
completeWarriorMutationCards.effect: Gain +2 on Intimidation checks. Enemies within 5 feet take -1 on morale checks or the campaign's equivalent morale roll; this does not alter attack rolls or saving throws.

source.originalText: | Pulsing Vein Spiral | Gain +2 to Intimidation and cause –1 morale on adjacent enemies |

completeWarriorMutationCards.name: Tremor Claws
completeWarriorMutationCards.rangeAndTarget: Creature critically hit by your melee attack
completeWarriorMutationCards.frequency: At most once per target per turn
completeWarriorMutationCards.effect: After a melee critical, the target makes a Strength save. On failure it falls Prone.

source.originalText: | Tremor Claws | Your melee crits force target to make STR save or fall prone |

completeWarriorMutationCards.name: Rib Lash Tendrils
completeWarriorMutationCards.effect: When a creature damages you with a melee attack, it takes 1d4 psychic damage. This retaliation cannot trigger itself or other retaliation loops.

source.originalText: | Rib Lash Tendrils | When you are hit in melee, deal 1d4 retaliatory psychic damage |

completeWarriorMutationCards.name: Bone Lure Growth
completeWarriorMutationCards.effect: The target makes a Wisdom save. On failure it must use up to 15 feet of its available movement to move toward you by the safest path. This movement cannot force it into obviously lethal terrain and never consumes its Action.

source.originalText: | Bone Lure Growth | Once per encounter, force 1 enemy within 4 tiles to move toward you (WIS save negates) |

completeWarriorMutationCards.name: Throat Split Maw
completeWarriorMutationCards.duration: Until end of target's next turn
completeWarriorMutationCards.effect: You gain a bite attack dealing 1d8+M piercing damage. When the bite hits a creature capable of casting spells, it makes a Constitution save; on failure it is Silenced until the end of its next turn.

source.originalText: | Throat Split Maw | Your bite attack silences casters for 1 round on hit |

completeWarriorMutationCards.name: Viral Core Sacs
completeWarriorMutationCards.duration: Until start of your next regular turn
completeWarriorMutationCards.effect: When you activate a serum, enemies within 10 feet make Constitution saves. On failure they have disadvantage on their next saving throw before the start of your next regular turn.

source.originalText: | Viral Core Sacs | When using a serum, release a 2x2 AoE that causes Disadvantage on saves for 1 round |

completeWarriorMutationCards.name: Scythebone Spikes
completeWarriorMutationCards.rangeAndTarget: Your unarmed strike target and one different adjacent creature
completeWarriorMutationCards.effect: When an unarmed strike hits, choose one different enemy within 5 feet of the original target. If the same attack roll would hit that enemy's AC, it takes damage equal to the unarmed strike's base damage die without modifiers. This cleave is not another attack and triggers no on-hit effects.

source.originalText: | Scythebone Spikes | Your unarmed strikes gain cleave (hit 2 adjacent targets) |

completeWarriorMutationCards.name: Carrion Signal Gland
completeWarriorMutationCards.rangeAndTarget: Creature that hits you in melee
completeWarriorMutationCards.duration: Until end of target's next turn
completeWarriorMutationCards.effect: The attacker makes a Wisdom save. On failure it becomes Shaken, taking -1 on attack rolls until the end of its next turn.

source.originalText: | Carrion Signal Gland | Enemies who hit you in melee must make WIS save or become Shaken |

completeWarriorMutationCards.name: Wailing Eye Cluster
completeWarriorMutationCards.duration: Until end of target's next turn
completeWarriorMutationCards.effect: Enemies make Wisdom saves. On failure they become Disoriented: at the start of their next turn they cannot take Reactions and their first 5 feet of movement must be in a random legal horizontal direction determined by the Director. They otherwise keep their normal Action and movement.

source.originalText: | Wailing Eye Cluster | As a bonus action 1/rest, emit a psychic scream: enemies within 3 tiles must save or become Disoriented (random movement) |

completeWarriorMutationCards.name: Voidbirth Shell
completeWarriorMutationCards.effect: You may move through enemy spaces and nonmagical difficult terrain without extra cost but cannot end inside a creature or solid object. Enemies within 15 feet take -1 on attack rolls and morale. At the end of each of your turns create one 1-HP clone in an adjacent legal space, maximum 2 clones. A clone cannot attack or block movement; when destroyed it explodes, creatures within 5 feet make Dexterity saves taking 2d6 psychic on failure or half on success. Clones grant no resources, corpses, XP or BT.
completeWarriorMutationCards.prerequisite: Warrior 15; Apex Aberrant; maximum one Apex equipped

source.originalText:
| Voidbirth Shell | While active:
- Gain Ethereal Movement (ignore terrain, move through enemies)
- Enemies within 3 tiles have –2 morale and suffer Weakened
- Each turn, summon 1 temporary clone (1 HP, explodes on death for 2d6 psychic)
- Lasts 3 rounds or until all clones are expended |

traits.name: Ability Score Increase
traits.text: Your Intelligence score increases by 2.

traits.name: Size
traits.text: Gnomes are between 3 and 4 feet tall and average about 40 pounds. Your size is Small.

traits.name: Speed
traits.text: Your base walking speed is 25 feet.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.text: Accustomed to life underground, you have superior vision in dark and dim conditions. You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

traits.name: Gnome Cunning
traits.text: You have advantage on all Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws against magic.

traits.name: Natural Curiosity
traits.text: You have proficiency in one of the following skills of your choice: Arcana, History, Investigation, or Nature.

traits.name: Languages
traits.text: You can speak, read, and write Common and Gnomish. The Gnomish language, which uses the Dwarvish script, is renowned for its technical treatises and its catalogs of knowledge about the natural world.

traits.name: Ability Score Increase
traits.text: Your Dexterity score increases by 1.

traits.name: Artificer's Lore
traits.text: Whenever you make an Intelligence (History) check related to magic items, alchemical objects, or technological devices, you can add twice your proficiency bonus, instead of any proficiency bonus you normally apply.

traits.name: Tinker
traits.text:
You have proficiency with artisan's tools (tinker's tools). Using those tools, you can spend 1 hour and 10 gp worth of materials to construct a Tiny clockwork device (AC 5, 1 hp). The device ceases to function after 24 hours (unless you spend 1 hour repairing it to keep the device functioning), or when you use your action to dismantle it; at that time, you can reclaim the materials used to create it. You can have up to three such devices active at a time.
When you create a device, choose one of the following options:

traits.name: Clockwork Toy
traits.text: This toy is a clockwork animal, monster, or person, such as a frog, mouse, bird, dragon, or soldier. When placed on the ground, the toy moves 5 feet across the ground on each of your turns in a random direction. It makes noises as appropriate to the creature it represents.

traits.name: Fire Starter
traits.text: The device produces a miniature flame, which you can use to light a candle, torch, or campfire. Using the device requires your action.

traits.name: Music Box
traits.text: When opened, this music box plays a single song at a moderate volume. The box stops playing when it reaches the song's end or when it is closed.

traits.name: Mechanical Sensor
traits.text: The device can detect the presence of creatures within 30 feet. When a creature enters or leaves this range, the device makes a chirping noise audible within 10 feet.

traits.name: Ability Score Increase
traits.text: Your Charisma score increases by 1.

traits.name: Natural Illusionist
traits.text: You know the minor illusion cantrip. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for it.

traits.name: Speak with Small Beasts
traits.text: Through sounds and gestures, you can communicate simple ideas with Small or smaller beasts. Arcanist gnomes love animals and often keep squirrels, badgers, rabbits, moles, woodpeckers, and other creatures as beloved pets.

traits.name: Arcane Tinkering
traits.text: When you cast a spell that deals damage, you can change the damage type to one of the following: acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

traits.name: Ability Score Increase
traits.text: Your Charisma score increases by 1.

traits.name: Minor Illusion
traits.text: You know the minor illusion cantrip. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for it.

traits.name: Distracting Prank
traits.text: As a bonus action, you can create a momentary distraction that causes a creature you can see within 30 feet to have disadvantage on the next Wisdom (Perception) or Intelligence (Investigation) check it makes before the end of your next turn. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

traits.name: Slippery Mind
traits.text: You have advantage on saving throws against being charmed or frightened.

traits.name: Ability Score Increase
traits.text: Your Strength score increases by 2, and your Constitution score increases by 1.

traits.name: Size
traits.text: Ogres stand between 8 and 10 feet tall and weigh between 600 and 800 pounds. Your size is Large.

traits.name: Speed
traits.text: Your base walking speed is 30 feet.

traits.name: Powerful Build
traits.text: You count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag, or lift.

traits.name: Natural Armor
traits.text: Your thick, leathery skin gives you a base AC of 12 + your Constitution modifier.

traits.name: Long-Limbed
traits.text: When you make a melee attack on your turn, your reach for it is 5 feet greater than normal.

traits.name: Languages
traits.text: You can speak, read, and write Common and Giant.

traits.name: Ability Score Increase
traits.text: Your Strength score increases by 1 (for a total of +3 to Strength).

traits.name: Stone's Endurance
traits.text: You can focus yourself to occasionally shrug off injury. When you take damage, you can use your reaction to roll a d12. Add your Constitution modifier to the number rolled and reduce the damage by that total. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

traits.name: Mountain Born
traits.text: You're acclimated to high altitude, including elevations above 20,000 feet. You're also naturally adapted to cold climates, as described by the environmental rules in Chapter 5.

traits.name: Mighty Thrower
traits.text: When you throw a weapon or object as part of an attack, its range increases by 30 feet.

traits.name: Ability Score Increase
traits.text: Your Charisma score increases by 1.

traits.name: Battle Cry
traits.text: As a bonus action, you can let out a mighty battle cry. Each ally within 30 feet of you who can hear you gains temporary hit points equal to your level. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

traits.name: Intimidating Presence
traits.text: You have proficiency in the Intimidation skill. When you use Intimidation against a creature that is your size or smaller, you have advantage on the check.

traits.name: Tactical Training
traits.text: You have proficiency with two martial weapons of your choice and with medium armor.

traits.name: Ability Score Increase
traits.text: Your Dexterity score increases by 1.

traits.name: Swamp Camouflage
traits.text: You have proficiency in the Stealth skill. When you attempt to hide in a swamp or marsh environment, you can do so even when only lightly obscured.

traits.name: Disease Resistance
traits.text: You have advantage on saving throws against disease and poison.

traits.name: Swamp Stride
traits.text: Moving through nonmagical difficult terrain in swamps and marshes costs you no extra movement.

traits.name: Nimble Escape

traits.name: Fury of the Small
traits.text: When you damage a creature with an attack or a spell and the creature's size is larger than yours, you can cause the attack or spell to deal extra damage to the creature. The extra damage equals your level. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

traits.name: Languages
traits.text: You can speak, read, and write Common and Goblin. The Goblin language is filled with hard consonants and guttural sounds, making it distinctive and somewhat difficult for other races to pronounce correctly.

traits.name: Ability Score Increase
traits.text: Your Intelligence score increases by 1.

traits.name: Demolition Expert
traits.text: You have proficiency with alchemist's supplies. When you make an Intelligence check related to alchemical substances, explosives, or incendiary devices, you can add twice your proficiency bonus, instead of any proficiency bonus you normally apply.

traits.name: Blast Resistance
traits.text: You have resistance to fire damage and advantage on Dexterity saving throws against effects that create explosions.

traits.name: Improvised Explosive
traits.text: As an action, you can create and throw a small explosive device. Choose a point within 30 feet. Each creature within 5 feet of that point must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw (DC = 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Intelligence modifier) or take 1d4 fire damage. This damage increases to 2d4 at 6th level, 3d4 at 11th level, and 4d4 at 16th level. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

traits.name: Ability Score Increase
traits.text: Your Wisdom score increases by 1.

traits.name: Junk Collector
traits.text: You have proficiency with tinker's tools. When you make a Wisdom (Perception) check to find useful items in junk, trash, or ruins, you can add twice your proficiency bonus, instead of any proficiency bonus you normally apply.

traits.name: Scavenger's Luck
traits.text: When you make a Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check or a Wisdom (Perception) check to find hidden objects, you can roll a d4 and add the number rolled to the check.

traits.name: Improvised Tool
traits.text:
As an action, you can create a simple tool or weapon from available materials. You create one of the following items, which lasts until you use this trait again:
A simple weapon
A set of thieves' tools
A climber's kit
A healing kit
Any other simple tool the Director agrees to
The item functions as a normal item of its kind but has half the normal hit points. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

traits.name: Ability Score Increase
traits.text: Your Charisma score increases by 1.

traits.name: Superior Darkvision
traits.text: Your darkvision has a radius of 120 feet.

traits.name: Shadow Stealth
traits.text: You have proficiency in the Stealth skill. When you are in dim light or darkness, you can take the Hide action as a bonus action.

traits.name: Shadow Blend
traits.text: When you are in dim light or darkness, you can use your action to become invisible until you move, take an action, or react. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

traits.name: Keen Senses

traits.name: Fey Ancestry

After resting in this way, you gain the same benefit that a human does from 8 hours of sleep.

traits.name: Languages

traits.name: Ability Score Increase

traits.name: Elf Weapon Training
traits.text: You have proficiency with the longsword, shortsword, shortbow, and longbow.

traits.name: Cantrip
traits.text: You know one cantrip of your choice from the wizard spell list. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for it.

traits.name: Extra Language
traits.text: You can speak, read, and write one extra language of your choice.

traits.name: Ability Score Increase
traits.text: Your Wisdom score increases by 1.

traits.name: Elf Weapon Training
traits.text: You have proficiency with the longsword, shortsword, shortbow, and longbow.

traits.name: Fleet of Foot
traits.text: Your base walking speed increases to 35 feet.

traits.name: Mask of the Wild
traits.text: You can attempt to hide even when you are only lightly obscured by foliage, heavy rain, falling snow, mist, and other natural phenomena.

traits.name: Ability Score Increase
traits.text: Your Charisma score increases by 1.

traits.name: Twilight Magic
traits.text: You know the minor illusion cantrip. When you reach 3rd level, you can cast the disguise self spell once per day. When you reach 5th level, you can also cast the misty step spell once per day. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells.

traits.name: Planar Affinity
traits.text: You have advantage on Intelligence checks related to the planes of existence, particularly the Verdant Reflection tradition of mortal planar cosmography.

traits.name: Shadow Step
traits.text: When you are in dim light or darkness, as a bonus action you can teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see that is also in dim light or darkness. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest.

FT84 source-follow-through selection (proposed; the following explicit interaction controls only this named composition):
FT84-Q03 / FT84-CLOSED-CREATION-01 — Craftsman applies to actual authorized creation, not names or all fixed-duration work.
INTERPRETATION SELECTED: personally leading an independently authorized closed feat process that makes/assembles a new usable physical body or prepared kit is eligible creation even when it is non-artisan, lacks a catalog recipe ID or prints a fixed base duration. Craftsman supplies only its half-active-time factor; it supplies no process, skill, formula, assistants, work opportunity, materials, use or output. Use the strongest genuinely applicable creation reduction once. An explicit source exclusion or distinct alteration/preparation/service category still controls. Keep actual physical minimum phases only where the source requires them; do not manufacture an advanced-recipe incorporation phase for every short feat process.
Contraption Crafter's ten minutes are the ordinary base for its real gadget construction. With actual personally leading Craftsman ownership the complete job is five uninterrupted active minutes, not ten with a final five-minute discount and not two-and-a-half from a second equivalent half. The whole adjusted job must be uninterrupted; phase logging, assistant handoff, pauses, rest or partially completed earlier attempts cannot satisfy it. A new lawful construction still ends its old gadget at start. Interruption spends the committed parts/use and yields no working gadget, no completion roll, no refundable tail and no resumable partial product. Completion rolls the same one d4 openly, once; it grants no chosen profile, duplicate gadget, general proficiency, quality, recipe XP or parts recovery. The same one-hour gadget lifetime starts at actual completion, not at the undiscounted hypothetical finish. Transfer/deployment/activation/recharge rules are unchanged. The time benefit is prospective and cannot manufacture a mid-job feat acquisition opportunity; if a real change interrupts the required work, the ordinary failure consequence applies.

completeAuthoringValue.proposedBorrowedProcedure:
KEEP this SUP-09 row's exact source ranger.base.nature-s-whisper, minimum borrower total level 1 and actualSourceClass Ranger. Use only the separately paid Versatile Mastery ability branch, its one-minute preparation within 5 feet, current conscious willing party donor within 30 feet who actually perceives and understands the signal, and its one-use/beneficial-rest and same-card recharge histories. The donor must actually hold the chosen unsuppressed, nonborrowed class grant. No Ranger level, repertoire, skill proficiency, pool or engine is copied. Pay the borrower's own legal Action and 1 actual personal RP plus its feat use at activation commitment; a valid generic Ready substitutes the setup Action and release Reaction as specified below. The donor pays nothing.

The following complete native operating procedure also controls this one borrowed activation; 'you' means the borrower. The native Ranger acquisition schedule is not imposed as a second acquisition gate on this expressly permitted borrowed route. This replaces only this row's former unresolved 'minorWeave/sharedcasting restrictions' wording, not the other eleven SUP-09 procedures:

Gain advantage on one Perception/Survival check to find tracks, hidden natural creatures or signs of passage. It reveals evidence on success, not automatically creatures through total cover, incorporeal beings or thoughts.

NEW NWQ-01 classification: this exact card is a magical nonspell class technique, not an ordinary spell, class spell, cantrip, Echo release or Matrix cast. Preserve spellRank:null and the historical originalText; no rank, school, spell component block, repertoire, spellcasting credential or class engine is inferred from its name, its historical minor-spell wording or its 1 RP cost.

NEW NWQ-02 activation: no verbal, somatic, focus, material, command-word or audible channel is required by the technique itself. You must be conscious, capable of the required Action, legitimately entitled to this exact activation, ready on its own recharge ledger, and able to perceive and have line of effect to the selected actual natural terrain within 15 feet. Silence, occupied hands or lack of a casting focus alone do not prohibit it. Actual suppression or a prohibition whose operative scope covers this magical technique still applies. The later investigation keeps its own senses, hands, tools, access and task requirements. A permitted borrowed activation separately requires Versatile Mastery's actual donor preparation, consent and perceived/understood signal; the technique supplies no communication channel.

KEEP shared technique strain: pay 1 actual RP from your own existing lawful personal pool, not a donor pool or newly granted pool. No ordinary spell-rank price, spell strain surcharge, automatic spell Dissonance, Refrain update, remembered-spell-name change, Fracture ranked-cast prohibition or rank-based trauma is applied by this activation. It does not clear, advance, consume or vent an ordinary spell-cadence record. Do not invent a casting ability or recompute a strain Limit for it. A later Perception or Survival check uses your own current applicable task ability and actual proficiency or replacing Expertise, ordinarily Wisdom, not a donor modifier or automatic borrowed skill proficiency. There is no activation attack or saving-throw DC. Its legal commitment is a magical-ability-use event: it prevents idle-turn Dissonance recovery on the actor's regular turn containing that commitment, including when the paid activation is interrupted. An illegal uncommitted declaration is not such an event. Merely retaining the rider or applying it to a later ordinary task is not another activation. Extra turns and off-turn releases create no additional recovery tick and cannot rewrite a completed tick. Actual separately acquired hooks operate only on their exact triggers; this is not a Bard Performance or an ordinary Ranger spell cast, and it grants no donor Track Target, Hit Chain, stabilization, Crescendo or Echo engine.

NEW NWQ-04 commitment and area: before payment, declare this source, actor and one fixed investigation area consisting only of the actual natural terrain within 15 feet of the actor's commitment position that is then perceivable and has line of effect. Record that area and position; the area does not follow the actor and no moving aura or remote sensor is created. Actual hidden clues need not already be known or present to make an otherwise lawful investigation site eligible. Commit the legal Action and 1 RP together, set the actor's same-card Recharge counter to 3, and, for borrowing, spend the single Versatile Mastery use at that same commitment. Record donor provenance without spending any donor resource. A rejected precommit declaration spends none of these costs. Resolve the activation within that same action after only genuinely applicable source-defined interruptions; there is no automatic Counterspell window, opposed cast roll or concentration test. Ordinary Counterspell and rank-limited spell dispels do not acquire this nonspell target. A separately sourced interrupt or suppression must actually cover it; ordinary damage alone does not add a concentration requirement. If the actor cannot finish the activation or its fixed terrain is no longer legally in range, perceivable and reachable by line of effect at resolution, the paid activation fails without a new area or refund. Borrowing's donor condition is tested at actual activation commitment, not imposed as a new continuing tether after receipt of the signal.

NEW NWQ-04 rider and check: a surviving activation gives this actor one unused rider from actual resolution until resolution time plus 60 elapsed seconds; the exact deadline is not renewed by travel, turns, initiative changes, donor departure or the borrowed permission ending. No concentration is required. At most one unused Nature's Whisper rider belongs to that actor across native and borrowed uses; a new successful resolution replaces an older unused rider, not stacks or banks checks. A failed or interrupted new activation does not itself replace an older otherwise valid rider. Before any dice or outcome are supplied, voluntarily bind the rider to one separately lawful and paid Perception or Survival check about tracks, hidden natural creatures or signs of passage in the original fixed area. The relevant terrain/evidence must still be natural, within 15 feet of the actor and accessible to the task's actual senses and line of effect; no total-cover, thoughts, incorporeal-detection or automatic-revelation exception is supplied. Consume the rider at that check's outcome commitment before rolling or determining its result, even if other advantage already exists, disadvantage cancels it, the legal check fails, or a genuine interruption then prevents its result. An invalid check declaration does not consume the rider or grant a free roll. A paid longer task whose check reaches adjudication at or after the deadline receives no rider. Use ordinary task resolution and advantage cancellation; no passive-score adjustment, extra degree effect, free check, new retry or second bonus is granted. Reveal only real evidence supported by the actual successful task and observer rules; unknown data is not proof of absence. Failure does not reveal otherwise hidden facts. Expired, consumed or ended riders cannot be reclaimed by repeating a request.

KEEP generic nonspell Ready: this Action-time technique may be readied through the current Ready procedure. Ready setup spends its Action and records one perceivable trigger; it does not activate Nature's Whisper, pay its RP/feat use, start its Recharge, start its minute, update spell history or create held-spell concentration. On a legal release before Ready expires, spend the required permitted Reaction and perform the actual activation commitment instead of another Action; recheck its own entitlement, recharge, personal RP, terrain and, for borrowing, the prepared donor/signal conditions at that release. An invalid or declined trigger spends no release resource and may await another valid trigger within the same Ready window. Unreleased, replaced or expired Ready loses its setup Action but not an unspent Nature/feat cost. A legally released then interrupted activation retains all committed costs and Recharge. Native and borrowed copies use the actor's same source-ID recharge history; borrowing does not refresh it or the donor's history. Recharge 3 ticks once at each subsequent owner regular-turn start, or once per six elapsed seconds outside initiative without double counting; extra Actions and extra turns do not tick it. A recharge becoming ready grants no new borrowed feat use.

originalSourceObject.description: Racial feat tied to Gnome heritage.
originalSourceObject.effect: Construct and deploy a temporary gadget with random utility (1/day).

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: Require actual Gnome heritage. NEW once per24 elapsed hours, spend10 uninterrupted minutes with actual usable tinkers tools and5gp of suitable owned mundane parts; commit the use and parts at construction start. The feat grants construction permission with these tools but no general tool proficiency. On completion roll1d4 openly on the four complete profiles below; no choice, reroll, duplicate product or refund for an unwanted result. One active feat gadget at a time; beginning a new legal construction ends the old gadget. Interrupted work loses the committed parts/use and yields no working gadget. The Tiny mundane object is1lb, AC10, HP1, has no creature turn/actions, and stops after1hour from completion or destruction. Place it in a reachable legal space or activate it with the profile's Action; moving/holding uses actual hands/object rules. Ownership can pass with the real object; its expiry/remaining uses travel with it and never reset. At expiry/dismantling it becomes inert spent parts with no reusable credited crafting value; no purchased tool/supply/consumable is replenished. Explicitly NEW economics, not a claim that original source named a price. It does not inherit Tinker Gnome's separate four clockwork profiles,10gp reclaim or maintenance loop, and creates no Tinker class device/attack/companion.

completeCurrentCard.name: Nature's Whisper
completeCurrentCard.effect:
Gain advantage on one Perception/Survival check to find tracks, hidden natural creatures or signs of passage. It reveals evidence on success, not automatically creatures through total cover, incorporeal beings or thoughts.

NEW NWQ-01 classification: this exact card is a magical nonspell class technique, not an ordinary spell, class spell, cantrip, Echo release or Matrix cast. Preserve spellRank:null and the historical originalText; no rank, school, spell component block, repertoire, spellcasting credential or class engine is inferred from its name, its historical minor-spell wording or its 1 RP cost.

NEW NWQ-02 activation: no verbal, somatic, focus, material, command-word or audible channel is required by the technique itself. You must be conscious, capable of the required Action, legitimately entitled to this exact activation, ready on its own recharge ledger, and able to perceive and have line of effect to the selected actual natural terrain within 15 feet. Silence, occupied hands or lack of a casting focus alone do not prohibit it. Actual suppression or a prohibition whose operative scope covers this magical technique still applies. The later investigation keeps its own senses, hands, tools, access and task requirements. A permitted borrowed activation separately requires Versatile Mastery's actual donor preparation, consent and perceived/understood signal; the technique supplies no communication channel.

KEEP shared technique strain: pay 1 actual RP from your own existing lawful personal pool, not a donor pool or newly granted pool. No ordinary spell-rank price, spell strain surcharge, automatic spell Dissonance, Refrain update, remembered-spell-name change, Fracture ranked-cast prohibition or rank-based trauma is applied by this activation. It does not clear, advance, consume or vent an ordinary spell-cadence record. Do not invent a casting ability or recompute a strain Limit for it. A later Perception or Survival check uses your own current applicable task ability and actual proficiency or replacing Expertise, ordinarily Wisdom, not a donor modifier or automatic borrowed skill proficiency. There is no activation attack or saving-throw DC. Its legal commitment is a magical-ability-use event: it prevents idle-turn Dissonance recovery on the actor's regular turn containing that commitment, including when the paid activation is interrupted. An illegal uncommitted declaration is not such an event. Merely retaining the rider or applying it to a later ordinary task is not another activation. Extra turns and off-turn releases create no additional recovery tick and cannot rewrite a completed tick. Actual separately acquired hooks operate only on their exact triggers; this is not a Bard Performance or an ordinary Ranger spell cast, and it grants no donor Track Target, Hit Chain, stabilization, Crescendo or Echo engine.

NEW NWQ-04 commitment and area: before payment, declare this source, actor and one fixed investigation area consisting only of the actual natural terrain within 15 feet of the actor's commitment position that is then perceivable and has line of effect. Record that area and position; the area does not follow the actor and no moving aura or remote sensor is created. Actual hidden clues need not already be known or present to make an otherwise lawful investigation site eligible. Commit the legal Action and 1 RP together, set the actor's same-card Recharge counter to 3, and, for borrowing, spend the single Versatile Mastery use at that same commitment. Record donor provenance without spending any donor resource. A rejected precommit declaration spends none of these costs. Resolve the activation within that same action after only genuinely applicable source-defined interruptions; there is no automatic Counterspell window, opposed cast roll or concentration test. Ordinary Counterspell and rank-limited spell dispels do not acquire this nonspell target. A separately sourced interrupt or suppression must actually cover it; ordinary damage alone does not add a concentration requirement. If the actor cannot finish the activation or its fixed terrain is no longer legally in range, perceivable and reachable by line of effect at resolution, the paid activation fails without a new area or refund. Borrowing's donor condition is tested at actual activation commitment, not imposed as a new continuing tether after receipt of the signal.

NEW NWQ-04 rider and check: a surviving activation gives this actor one unused rider from actual resolution until resolution time plus 60 elapsed seconds; the exact deadline is not renewed by travel, turns, initiative changes, donor departure or the borrowed permission ending. No concentration is required. At most one unused Nature's Whisper rider belongs to that actor across native and borrowed uses; a new successful resolution replaces an older unused rider, not stacks or banks checks. A failed or interrupted new activation does not itself replace an older otherwise valid rider. Before any dice or outcome are supplied, voluntarily bind the rider to one separately lawful and paid Perception or Survival check about tracks, hidden natural creatures or signs of passage in the original fixed area. The relevant terrain/evidence must still be natural, within 15 feet of the actor and accessible to the task's actual senses and line of effect; no total-cover, thoughts, incorporeal-detection or automatic-revelation exception is supplied. Consume the rider at that check's outcome commitment before rolling or determining its result, even if other advantage already exists, disadvantage cancels it, the legal check fails, or a genuine interruption then prevents its result. An invalid check declaration does not consume the rider or grant a free roll. A paid longer task whose check reaches adjudication at or after the deadline receives no rider. Use ordinary task resolution and advantage cancellation; no passive-score adjustment, extra degree effect, free check, new retry or second bonus is granted.
